tools.name: contract_risk_summary
tools.description: Analyze a deployed smart contract and return a deterministic risk report: 0-100 score with level (low/medium/high/critical), proxy/upgradeability, owner and pause state, risky selectors found in the bytecode (mint, blacklist, fee/tax setters, pause, upgrade), SELFDESTRUCT/DELEGATECALL opcodes, sourc

tools.name: contract_quick_flags
tools.description: Free, no payment: bytecode-only preview of a deployed smart contract. Covers proxy/upgradeability, ERC-20 probe (name, symbol, owner, paused), risky selectors found in the bytecode (mint, blacklist, fee/tax setters, pause, upgrade), SELFDESTRUCT/DELEGATECALL opcodes, and a partialScore/partialLevel

tools.name: supported_chains
tools.description: List the EVM chains contract_risk_summary can analyze, as { chainId, name, testnet } objects. Free, read-only, no payment and no parameters. Call it when you need to map a chain name to its id or to check coverage before paying for a report.

tools.name: scoring_rubric
tools.description: Return the exact rubric behind contract_risk_summary scores: points per flag, the level thresholds and what each flag means. Free, read-only, no parameters. Call it to explain a score to a user or to decide your own threshold before acting on a report.
